title: Karnak von Runcandel
dek: An earnest protector who seeks to prove conviction through action while learning to decide alongside stronger companions.
sources: Supplied character deep dives · 11 October 2026; interpretation checked against selected primary scenes where available.
Main quest RP and Alpine Forest · selected primary exchanges
body:
Karnak introduces himself as a Hellion of Archduchess Zariel and says he is invested in protecting Prima. He wants his actions to justify that duty: strength matters to him because he treats competence as proof of conviction. His story follows the difficult work of becoming a protector alongside people whose confidence and experience exceed his own.

A duty he chooses to name

In the April 2026 quest exchange, Karnak says he does not know how he reached this world, but names protection of Prima as his purpose. This establishes his own commitment, rather than an official appointment or a town-wide judgment of his service. His reasons for becoming a Hellion, and the duties that preceded his arrival, remain unknown.

Primary scene: 1. Dates refer to Discord posts.

29 April 2026 · Proving conviction

In the Alpine Forest, Severina asks whether Karnak wants to overcome an attacker himself or have her finish it. He insists on doing it himself to become stronger and prove his conviction. She warns him about his wounds, but remains ready to act if he falls. He is given room to try without being abandoned.

Primary scene: 1, 2, 3. Dates refer to Discord posts.

“I will do it myself need to be better and stronger to prove my convition”Karnak · Alpine Forest, 29 April 2026 posting date

When vigilance needs a decision

In a May expedition, Karnak argues for caution around an unfamiliar threat and says they should approach with vigilance. Severina challenges him to act. The exchange shows a tension between asking for a plan and making a decision: caution can protect the party, but his principles still need to become action. It does not establish cowardice or settle how he responds in every encounter.

Primary scene: 1, 2, 3. Dates refer to Discord posts.

Protection directed toward someone else

During the same expedition, Karnak uses a seal to place a shadow shroud on Camilla, telling her she needs it more than he does. Here his contribution is another person’s protection, rather than proof that he can defeat a threat alone. The record does not establish the full origin or mechanics of the seal.

Primary scene: 1, 2. Dates refer to Discord posts.

The unfinished protector

Karnak’s recurring partnership with Severina makes independence a meaningful question. He respects her competence and accepts support while seeking chances to stand on his own. The supplied dossier reads this as conviction struggling with dependence; the scenes support that interpretation without proving his private motives. His earlier life, the convictions he would refuse to compromise, and what he wants beyond greater strength remain open.
